note: Identifier shapes the tracker must refuse from identify() and the collector must detect in user_id. Two halves of one rule, in two languages, read by internal/service and sdk/test from this one file so they cannot drift apart quietly. Every value here is invented.

refused.why: a Korean mobile number as it is actually written
the same number with no separators
the same number in international form
the same number with no separator
a long run of digits inside an identifier

allowed.why: an employee number, which is what identify() is for
an account name with no contact detail in it
a short number in a name is not an identifier
